description: This file contains the implementation of a node host runner, including configuration handling, gateway client setup, skill bin management, and event handling for invoking skills in a distributed system.

classes.name: SkillBinsCache
classes.description: A cache for skill bin trust entries with TTL-based refresh.

methods.name: writeStderrLine
methods.description: Writes a message to standard error with a newline.

methods.name: resolveExecutablePathFromEnv
methods.description: Resolves the executable path from environment variables if the binary name does not contain a path.

methods.name: resolveSkillBinTrustEntries
methods.description: Resolves and sorts skill bin trust entries from a list of bin names.

methods.name: SkillBinsCache.current
methods.description: Returns current skill bin trust entries, refreshing if needed.

methods.name: SkillBinsCache.refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the skill bin trust entries cache.

methods.name: ensureNodePathEnv
methods.description: Ensures the PATH environment variable includes standard directories.

methods.name: resolveNodeHostGatewayCredentials
methods.description: Resolves credentials for the node host gateway based on configuration.

methods.name: buildNodeHostLocalAuthConfig
methods.description: Builds a local auth config by removing remote tokens/passwords if present.

methods.name: runNodeHost
methods.description: Main function to run the node host, setting up configuration, gateway client, and event handling.
